Name: AutoClavicle
Description: This will create an automatic clavicle reader system.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create an automatic clavicle reader system.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- ClavicleCtrl: set the clavicle control name.
- FKShoulderCtrl: set the FK shoulder controller name.
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
